        "contents": "const RESERVED_ROUTES = [\n 'field-mapping-management'\n];\n\n/**\n * 根据地址（address）加载公开页面配置并渲染对应模版的页面\n * 路由：/ai-search, /tech-package 等\n */\nconst AddressPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { address } = useParams&lt;{ address: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!address) {\n        setError('地址参数缺失');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 检查是否是保留路由\n      if (RESERVED_ROUTES.includes(address)) {\n        setError('该路径为系统保留路径');\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n        // 根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(address);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n        } else {\n          setError('未找到对应的页面配置');\n        }\n      } catch (err: any) {\n        console.error('加载配置失败:', err);\n        // 如果404，说明不是有效的地址配置，跳转到首页\n        if (err.response?.status === 404) {\n          navigate('/');\n          return;\n        }\n        setError(err.message || '加载配置失败');\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [address, navigate]);\n\n  // 处理节点执行\n  const handleNodeExecution = async (inputData: any)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import { useParams, useNavigate } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport { ArrowLeft, Calendar, User, Tag, Settings, Zap } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { carSeriesService } from \"../../services/carSeriesService\";\nimport { CarSeries } from \"../../types/carSeries\";\nimport { TechPoint } from \"../../types/techPoint\";\n\nconst CarSeriesDetailPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { id } = useParams&lt;{ id: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [carSeries, setCarSeries] = useState&lt;CarSeries | null&gt;(null);\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&lt;TechPoint[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const fetchData = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!id) return;\n\n      try {\n        setLoading(true);\n        setError(null);\n\n        // 获取车系详情\n        const carSeriesResponse = await carSeriesService.getById(parseInt(id));\n        if (carSeriesResponse.success &amp;&amp; carSeriesResponse.data) {\n          setCarSeries(carSeriesResponse.data);\n        } else {\n          setError(\"获取车系信息失败\");\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // 获取关联的技术点\n        const techPointsResponse = await carSeriesService.getTechPoints(\n          parseInt(id),\n        );\n        if (techPointsResponse.success &amp;&amp; techPointsResponse.data) {\n          setTechPoints(techPointsResponse.data);\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error(\"获取数据失败:\", err);\n        setError(\"获取数据失败，请稍后重试\");\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchData();\n  }, [id]);\n\n  const formatDate = (dateString: string) =&gt; {\n    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\");\n  };\n\n  const getStatusColor = (status: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AddressPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 如果配置的模板类型是 speech，使用发布会稿页面\n  if (publicConfig.config.templateType === 'speech') {\n    return &lt;PressReleasePage /&gt;;\n  }\n\n  // 默认使用技术包装页面（如果模板类型是 tech-package 或其他）\n  if (publicConfig.config.templateType === 'tech-package') {\n    return &lt;TechPackagePage /&gt;;\n  }\n\n  // 如果没有指定模板类型，默认使用技术包装页面\n  return &lt;TechPackagePage /&gt;;\n\n  // 其他模板类型可以在这里扩展\n  return (\n    &lt;PageTransition isVisible={true}&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4\"&gt;模版类型不支持&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-gray-600 mb-4\"&gt;\n            当前配置的模版类型暂不支持显示\n          &lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={() =&gt; navigate(\"/\")}\n            className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700\"\n          &gt;\n            返回首页\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/PageTransition&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default AddressPage;",

## 代码结构

三个页面组件代码结构相同，都使用 `BaseAISearchPage`，仅传入不同的配置对象。

## 主要差异

### 1. 页面标题
- `tech-package`: "技术包装"
- `tech-strategy`: "技术策略"
- `tech-article`: "技术通稿"

### 2. 工具标签显示
- `tech-package` 使用简化标签："五看"、"三定"、"传播"
- `tech-strategy` 和 `tech-article` 使用详细标签："技术转译"、"用户场景挖掘"、"传播策略"

### 3. 可用工具数量（核心差异）

| 页面 | 启用工具数量 | 启用的工具 |
|------|------------|-----------|
| **tech-package** | **8个**（全部） | 五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译、技术讲稿、脚本 |
| **tech-strategy** | **4个** | 传播策略、技术转译、用户场景挖掘、翻译 |
| **tech-article** | **2个**（最少） | 技术讲稿、翻译 |

### 4. 工作流选择键
每个页面使用不同的 localStorage 键来保存用户的工作流选择偏好。

已生成对比文档 `页面代码对比分析.md`，包含详细对比信息。三个页面采用配置驱动设计，共享同一基础组件，通过配置实现功能差异化。

void;\n  onSelectionChange?: (selectedIds: string[]) =&gt; void;\n  pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article';\n}\n\n// 获取来源类别的显示信息\nconst getCategoryInfo = (category?: SourceCategory) =&gt; {\n  switch (category) {\n    case 'technical-translation':\n      return {\n        label: '技术转译',\n        icon: FileCode,\n        color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-blue-600',\n      };\n    case 'ai-qa-summary':\n      return {\n        label: 'AI问答总结',\n        icon: Brain,\n        color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-purple-600',\n      };\n    case 'tech-package-qa':\n      return {\n        label: '技术包装问答',\n        icon: Package,\n        color: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-orange-600',\n      };\n    case 'tech-strategy-qa':\n      return {\n        label: '技术策略问答',\n        icon: Target,\n        color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-green-600',\n      };\n    case 'tech-article-qa':\n      return {\n        label: '技术通稿问答',\n        icon: Newspaper,\n        color: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-indigo-600',\n      };\n    case 'external':\n    default:\n      return {\n        label: '外部来源',\n        icon: FileText,\n        color: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700',\n        iconColor: 'text-gray-600',\n      };\n  }\n};\n\nconst SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  sources = [],\n  selectedSources = [],\n  onSourcesChange,\n  onSelectionChange,\n  pageType,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showTextModal, setShowTextModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showKnowledgeBrowser, setShowKnowledgeBrowser] = useState(false);\n  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState&lt;Source | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isSelectAll, setIsSelectAll] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleAddSource = () =&gt; {\n    setShowTextModal(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleExplore = () =&gt; {\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&gt; {\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      if (newSelectAll) {\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&gt; s.id));\n      } else {\n        onSelectionChange([]);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&gt; {\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;&amp; sources.length &gt; 0);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceClick = (source: Source) =&gt; {\n    setEditingSource(source);\n  };\n\n  const handleUpdateSource = (updatedSource: Source) =&gt; {\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.map((s) =&gt;\n        s.id === updatedSource.id ? updatedSource : s\n      );\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n    }\n    setEditingSource(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; s.id !== sourceId);\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\n        onSelectionChange(\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddExternalSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;external_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    setShowAddModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleAddTextSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;text_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;, // 确保ID唯一\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    // 默认选中新添加的来源\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      onSelectionChange([...selectedSources, source.id]);\n    }\n    setShowTextModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase = (selectedItems: any[]) =&gt; {\n    const newSources: Source[] = selectedItems.map((item) =&gt; ({\n      id: &#96;kb_${item.id}&#96;,\n      title: item.title || item.techPoint || \"未命名知识点\",\n      type: \"knowledge_base\" as const,\n      description: item.description,\n    }));\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, ...newSources]);\n    }\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-64 h-full bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col\"&gt;\n      {/* 标题和操作按钮 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"p-4 border-b border-gray-200\"&gt;\n        &lt;h2 className=\"text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-3\"&gt;来源&lt;/h2&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex gap-2\"&gt;\n          &lt;button\n            onClick={handleAddSource}\n            className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors text-sm font-medium\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;Plus className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n            添加信息\n          &lt;/button&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 选择所有来源 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-200\"&gt;\n        &lt;label className=\"flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer\"&gt;\n          &lt;input\n            type=\"checkbox\"\n            checked={isSelectAll}\n            onChange={handleSelectAll}\n            className=\"w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 rounded border-gray-300 focus:ring-blue-500\"\n          /&gt;\n          &lt;span className=\"text-sm text-gray-700\"&gt;选择所有来源&lt;/span&gt;\n        &lt;/label&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 来源列表 */}\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 overflow-y-auto\"&gt;\n        {sources.length === 0 ? (\n          &lt;div className=\"p-4 text-center text-gray-500 text-sm\"&gt;\n            暂无来源，点击\"添加信息\"添加来源\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        ) : (\n          &lt;div className=\"p-2\"&gt;\n            {sources.map((source) =&gt; {\n              const categoryInfo = getCategoryInfo(source.category);\n              const IconComponent = categoryInfo.icon;\n              \n              return (\n                &lt;div\n                  key={source.id}\n                  onClick={() =&gt; handleSourceClick(source)}\n                  className=\"flex items-start gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors group cursor-pointer\"\n                &gt;\n                  &lt;input\n                    type=\"checkbox\"\n                    checked={selectedSources.includes(source.id)}\n                    onChange={() =&gt; handleSourceToggle(source.id)}\n                    onClick={(e) =&gt; e.stopPropagation()}\n                    className=\"w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 rounded border-gray-300 focus:ring-blue-500 mt-1\"\n                  /&gt;\n                  &lt;IconComponent className={&#96;w-5 h-5 ${categoryInfo.iconColor} flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5&#96;} /&gt;\n                  &lt;div className=\"flex-1 min-w-0\"&gt;\n                    &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-gray-900 truncate\"&gt;\n                      {source.title}\n                    &lt;/p&gt;\n                    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-1\"&gt;\n                      &lt;span className={&#96;inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium ${categoryInfo.color}&#96;}&gt;\n                        {categoryInfo.label}\n                      &lt;/span&gt;\n                    &lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;div className=\"flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity\"&gt;\n                    &lt;button\n                      onClick={(e) =&gt; handleDeleteSource(source.id, e)}\n                      className=\"p-1 hover:bg-gray-200 rounded transition-colors\"\n                      title=\"删除\"\n                    &gt;\n                      &lt;X className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-500\" /&gt;\n                    &lt;/button&gt;\n                  &lt;/div&gt;\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n              );\n            })}\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        )}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n      {/* 跳转链接区域 - 固定在底部 */}\n      {pageType === 'tech-package' &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;div className=\"p-4 border-t border-gray-200\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n            &lt;button\n              onClick={() =&gt; navigate('/tech-strategy')}\n              className=\"w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors text-sm font-medium\"\n            &gt;\n              技术策略\n            &lt;/button&gt;\n            &lt;button\n              onClick={() =&gt; navigate('/tech-article')}\n              className=\"w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors text-sm font-medium\"\n            &gt;\n              技术通稿\n            &lt;/button&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      )}\n\n      {/* 添加文本来源弹窗 */}\n      {showTextModal &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;AddTextModal\n          onClose={() =&gt; setShowTextModal(false)}\n          onAddTextSource={handleAddTextSource}\n          pageType={pageType}\n        /&gt;\n      )}\n\n      {/* 添加来源弹窗 */}\n      {showAddModal &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;AddSourceModal\n          onClose={() =&gt; setShowAddModal(false)}\n          onAddExternalSource={handleAddExternalSource}\n          pageType={pageType}\n        /&gt;\n      )}\n\n      {/* 知识库浏览器 */}\n      {showKnowledgeBrowser &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;KnowledgeBaseBrowser\n          onClose={() =&gt; setShowKnowledgeBrowser(false)}\n          onSelect={handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase}\n        /&gt;\n      )}\n\n      {/* 编辑来源弹窗 */}\n      {editingSource &amp;&amp; (\n        &lt;EditSourceModal\n          source={editingSource}\n          onClose={() =&gt; setEditingSource(null)}\n          onUpdate={handleUpdateSource}\n        /&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default SourceSidebar;\n\n",

        "contents": "const SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  sources = [],\n  selectedSources = [],\n  onSourcesChange,\n  onSelectionChange,\n  pageType,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showTextModal, setShowTextModal] = useState(false);\n  const [showKnowledgeBrowser, setShowKnowledgeBrowser] = useState(false);\n  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState&lt;Source | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isSelectAll, setIsSelectAll] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleAddSource = () =&gt; {\n    setShowTextModal(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleExplore = () =&gt; {\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectAll = () =&gt; {\n    const newSelectAll = !isSelectAll;\n    setIsSelectAll(newSelectAll);\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      if (newSelectAll) {\n        onSelectionChange(sources.map((s) =&gt; s.id));\n      } else {\n        onSelectionChange([]);\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceToggle = (sourceId: string) =&gt; {\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      const newSelection = selectedSources.includes(sourceId)\n        ? selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        : [...selectedSources, sourceId];\n      onSelectionChange(newSelection);\n      setIsSelectAll(newSelection.length === sources.length &amp;&amp; sources.length &gt; 0);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSourceClick = (source: Source) =&gt; {\n    setEditingSource(source);\n  };\n\n  const handleUpdateSource = (updatedSource: Source) =&gt; {\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.map((s) =&gt;\n        s.id === updatedSource.id ? updatedSource : s\n      );\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n    }\n    setEditingSource(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const pageTypeToLoad = projectId ? &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96; : config.pageType;\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', pageTypeToLoad);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(pageTypeToLoad);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 合并现有来源和数据库中的来源，避免重复\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          // 先添加现有来源\n          prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length);\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到页面类型的来源信息');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadPageTypeSources = \n [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const urlSourceIds = searchParams.getAll('sourceId'); // 获取所有的 sourceId 参数\n    if (urlSourceIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; sources.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 检测到 URL 参数中的 sourceIds:', urlSourceIds);\n      \n      const newSelectedIds: string[] = [];\n      let hasNewSelection = false;\n      \n      // 检查每个 sourceId 是否存在于来源中，并添加到选中列表\n      urlSourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&gt; {\n        const foundSource = sources.find(s =&gt; s.id === sourceId);\n        if (foundSource) {\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 找到匹配的来源，自动选中:', foundSource.title);\n          newSelectedIds.push(sourceId);\n          hasNewSelection = true;\n        } else {\n          console.warn('[SourceInfo] URL 参数中的 sourceId 不存在于加载的来源中:', sourceId);\n        }\n      });\n      \n      // 如果有新的选中项，更新选中列表\n      if (hasNewSelection) {\n        setSelectedSourceIds(prev =&gt; {\n          const combined = [...prev];\n          newSelectedIds.forEach(id =&gt; {\n            if (!combined.includes(id)) {\n              combined.push(id);\n            }\n          });\n          return combined;\n        });\n        \n        // 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复选中\n        const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\n        newSearchParams.delete('sourceId');\n        setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\n      }\n    }\n  }, [sources, searchParams, setSearchParams]);\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; s.id !== sourceId);\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\n        onSelectionChange(\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddExternalSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;external_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    setShowAddModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleAddTextSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;text_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;, // 确保ID唯一\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    // 默认选中新添加的来源\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      onSelectionChange([...selectedSources, source.id]);\n    }\n    setShowTextModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase = (selectedItems: any[]) =&gt; {\n    const newSources: Source[] = selectedItems.map((item) =&gt; ({\n      id: &#96;kb_${item.id}&#96;,\n      title: item.title || item.techPoint || \"未命名知识点\",\n      type: \"knowledge_base\" as const,\n      description: item.description,\n    }));\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, ...newSources]);\n    }\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"w-64 h-full bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n        if (!options?.append) {\n          try {\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载对话来源信息:', conversationId);\n            const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n            console.log('[SourceInfo] 对话来源加载结果:', {\n              success: sourceResult.success,\n              count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n              error: sourceResult.error\n            });\n            \n            const dbSources = sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data ? sourceResult.data : [];\n            const conversationSources = detail.sources || [];\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 对话来源 + 数据库来源\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加对话中的来源\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，至少保留对话中的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const AISearchPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 先尝试清理乱码文件\n      try {\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\"../services/api\");\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\n      } catch (error) {\n        // 清理失败不影响文件列表加载\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\n      }\n\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType });\n      // 将文件转换为Source格式\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&#96;,\n        title: file.name,\n        type: 'external' as const,\n        url: file.url,\n        description: &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&#96;,\n      }));\n      \n      // 完全替换文件来源，避免重复\n      setSources((prev) =&gt; {\n        // 保留非文件来源（知识库来源等）\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n        // 使用数据库中的文件列表，完全替换文件来源\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, [pageType]);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\n  };\n\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载工作流列表失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载工作流列表失败\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [reportError]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt;\n;\n  }\n;",

## 修改内容

1. 在“暂无来源”提示区域添加跳转入口
   - 当 `pageType === 'tech-strategy'` 且没有来源时，在提示文字下方显示两个跳转按钮：
     - "技术包装" → 跳转到 `/tech-package`
     - "技术通稿" → 跳转到 `/tech-article`

2. 在底部固定区域添加跳转入口
   - 在 `SourceSidebar` 底部（类似 `tech-package` 页面的底部区域）添加跳转按钮
   - 无论是否有来源，都会显示在底部

## 效果

- 当 `tech-strategy` 页面没有来源时，会在“暂无来源”提示下方显示跳转按钮
- 底部固定区域始终显示跳转按钮，方便快速切换页面

跳转按钮样式与 `tech-package` 页面保持一致，使用灰色背景和悬停效果。
